name: latex-comfort-ai-experimental
description: Experimental LaTeX Comfort AI build with Editor Inset review.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter latex-comfort-ai build:webview && node esbuild.mjs && node copy-webview.mjs
scripts.package: pnpm build && npx --yes @vscode/vsce@latest package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --readme-path README-experimental.md -o latex-comfort-ai-experimental-0.1.0.vsix

commands.title: LaTeX Comfort AI: Configure Review Surface
LaTeX Comfort AI: Configure OpenCode Review

latexComfort.ai.model.description: Model name. Provider presets use their own defaults when empty. For vscode-lm this can be a model id or family.

latexComfort.ai.maxChars.description: Maximum selected characters for one AI edit.

enumDescriptions: Choose automatically: editor card for short selections when available, native inline as fallback, and the side panel for long reviews.
Stable decoration + CodeLens review directly in the editor.
Lattice-style review card below the selection using the Proposed editorInsets API. Falls back when unavailable.
Show the full review card beside the editor. Best for long selections.
latexComfort.ai.review.presentation.markdownDescription:
Where to review AI edits. Run **LaTeX Comfort AI: Configure Review Surface** from the Command Palette for a guided picker.

`auto` prefers the experimental editor card for short selections, falls back to native inline, and uses the side panel for long reviews.

latexComfort.ai.agent.opencodePath.description: OpenCode executable used for ACP agent runs. OpenCode 2 exposes the same `opencode acp` command.

latexComfort.ai.agent.codexAcpPath.description: Codex ACP bridge executable. Install it with `npm install -g @agentclientprotocol/codex-acp` if it is not on PATH.

latexComfort.ai.agent.codexPath.description: Codex CLI executable passed to the ACP bridge through CODEX_PATH.

latexComfort.ai.agent.opencodeModel.description: Preferred OpenCode model value. Leave empty to choose from the ACP model list on each run.

latexComfort.ai.agent.codexModel.description: Preferred Codex model value. Leave empty to choose from the ACP model list on each run.

enumDescriptions: Never show tool permission prompts. The agent applies its changes without asking.
Auto-approve routine edits inside the workspace, but ask before shell commands, deletes, network access, and edits outside the workspace.
Ask before every file edit and command, showing the proposed change before it is applied.
latexComfort.ai.agent.approvalMode.markdownDescription:
How the agent asks for permission before acting.

`approval-required` is recommended for LaTeX writing: every edit shows its diff before the file changes.

OpenCode only sends these requests when its own `permissions` rules resolve to `ask`; run **LaTeX Comfort AI: Configure OpenCode Review** if edits are applied without a prompt.

latexComfort.ai.agent.review.autoOpenDif.description: Open the turn's combined diff automatically when the agent finishes. When off, a Review changes button appears in the status bar and the history menu still opens diffs.
